text.description_html:
AHI SIG110/SIG200PA-902120, Abbeyville Stainless Steel Lever with Round Rose and Spindle

The AHI made SIG110 has a round rose and a square flat grip which mounts at the rose is at a 90 degree angle. This is a great addition to match other modern hardware in your home. The lever is all stainless steel, making it resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasions. Durable in appearance and function even after years of use on your home or office. This set is packaged with 2 levers, 2 rosettes, and a spindle. It does not include a latch, subrose or strike plate.

Specifications of the Stainless Steel Abbeyville Lever Pair with Spindle:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Lever Length: 4-15/16" (126 mm)
  • Lever Grip Thickness: 13/16" (21 mm) x 1/2" (13 mm)
  • Projection: 2-1/4" (57 mm)
  • Spindle Width: 5/16" (8 mm)
  • Rose Diameter: 2-1/16" (52 mm)
  • Rose Thickness: 7/16" (11 mm)

Package Includes: a pair (2) SIG110 levers, a pair (2) of SIG200 round roses, and (1) 8mm x 120mm spindle

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
